m: यूष m. n. (fr. √ 2. यु) soup, broth, pease-soup, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled, GṛŚrS.; Kathās.; Suśr.
यूष m. the Indian mulberry tree, L.
यूष [cf. Lat. jūs; Slav. jucha.]
a: यूषः --षं यूषन् — m. n. Soup, broth pease-soup. (यूषन् has no forms for the first five inflections, and is optionally substituted for यूष after acc. dual).

m: यूषन् (only in the weak cases यूष्णा, ˚णस्; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63) id., RV.; VS.; TS.
